# Upstream downloader

`downloadPages.js` is the original browser script from [apankowski/doc88-downloader](https://github.com/apankowski/doc88-downloader), retained unchanged.

The upstream project offers MIT No Attribution or Unlicense terms. The original license text is included in `LICENSE`.

The local application runs this script through Chrome DevTools Protocol and processes its ZIP outside the Doc88 page. OCR dependencies are never injected into Doc88.
